description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. Mahinda Rajapaksa MP, to the Office of Prime Minister
categorisation: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa) to a government position (Prime Minister). It names the person and provides the basic title of the office, but does not include any detailed description of portfolio responsibilities, ministerial duties, or subject areas the appointee will oversee. This fits the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette) which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
